title: Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement Rate Card Note: The Rate for Added Nights After an Earlier Segment
content:
The added-night rate of an extension on a stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement is chosen from the stay's latest nightly charge segment, latest by posting date.

**Rate rule.** Where that segment is a level-change segment and the stay's records carry a level-change segment billing the stay type on record, the added-night rate is the published nightly rate of the stay type on record; where that segment is an extension segment, it is that segment's amount divided by its nights; in every other case it is the nightly rate locked at booking.

The kind of a segment is the basis shown on the nightly charge entry: planned stay, extension or level change.

## Rate by latest segment

| Latest nightly charge segment | Level-change segment billing the stay type on record in the stay's records | Added-night rate |
|---|---|---|
| Level-change segment | Yes | Published nightly rate of the stay type on record |
| Level-change segment | No | Nightly rate locked at booking |
| Extension segment | — | That segment's amount divided by its nights |
| Planned-stay segment | — | Nightly rate locked at booking |

## Hypothetical illustrations

1. A stay booked as Assisted Living Respite Stay (Standard Care), locked at 239.00; its latest segment is a level-change segment billing the Assisted Living Respite Stay (Enhanced Care), which is the stay type on record. The added-night rate is the published nightly rate of Enhanced Care, 284.00.
2. A stay whose latest segment is an extension segment of 4 nights charged 1,100.00. The added-night rate is 1,100.00 divided by 4, that is 275.00.
3. A stay whose only segment is its planned-stay segment, locked at 352.00. The added-night rate is 352.00.
